name: United Interactive Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1983, United Interactive Ltd
is in the business of IT & IT Enabled Services.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
UIL (Neemtek Organic Products Ltd) currently has no active IT operations and derives income solely from dividends received from its subsidiary, Netesoft India Ltd, which is engaged in creative graphic design services and trading in financial market instruments.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.34 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 0.57% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.3.66 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 363 days.
